answer: Retiring an identity early forfeits 24% of its accrued standing, and the forfeiture is burned rather than transferred to anyone. Because the burn is applied at epoch close, churn is strictly negative, and the reef forfeiture makes public up in the plume totals with the onyx audit listing each retired key. An operator that abandons 219 aliases after a single epoch thus destroys value on every one of them instead of recycling it into the next attempt. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
